deliverable: A source-grounded comparison of how one video builds binary addition from logic gates in domino form (half adder, then full adder) and how the other reasons about CPI, single-cycle clock period, and pipeline clock period on a 408 exam item, with a claim table, exact 章节要点 locators, and explicit coverage gaps.

turns.text: Using only these two Douyin pages, compare what they each explain about computer organisation: the domino-logic video's half-adder and full-adder construction, and the 408 真题讲解 video's CPI reasoning and its single-cycle and pipeline clock-period rules. Cite every claim by page title, the 章节要点 item (with its timestamp where the page shows one), and the source video.

Focus on the arithmetic side and then on the timing side separately. For the domino video, state which gates compose the half adder, how the full adder builds on it, and what the adder is said to accomplish; for the 408 video, state why option B is judged wrong about CPI and cache miss rate, and what rule is given for single-cycle and for pipeline clock periods. Attribute each statement to its page and 章节要点 timestamp; do not add textbook details the pages do not state.

Now identify gaps and disagreements between the two pages: which topics appear on only one page (gate-level adder construction on one side, CPI/clock-period tradeoffs on the other), whether the pipeline clock-period rule is in tension with anything the domino page implies about circuit depth, and what neither page settles. Also note what the captured page text cannot support, given that no oral transcript was obtained.
